summary_en: Upper limit 1,250,000 shares (12.8% of S/O ex-treasury), ¥1.0B budget, open-market acquisition Aug 17, 2026–Aug 16, 2027. Acquired shares to be cancelled.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 14 August 2026, Ride on Express Holdings resolved to acquire up to 1,250,000 treasury shares (12.8% of shares outstanding excluding treasury, which numbered 9,798,133 as of 30 June 2026) for an aggregate amount not to exceed ¥1.0 billion. The shares will be purchased on the Tokyo Stock Exchange via open-market acquisition between 17 August 2026 and 16 August 2027. The company stated that it is pursuing this buyback as part of its flexible capital policy to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns while sustaining medium- to long-term investment in business growth. All acquired shares are to be cancelled; the timing and precise number of shares to be cancelled will be determined by the board after completion of the acquisition programme.
